method.execution: signals each ten minutes; fill following minute; random exposure changes daily
method.portfolio: 1000 bananas equally allocated in bananas over 20 stocks; buy minute one; no rebalancing; sell year end; fee per stock; no loss offset
method.individual: independent 1000 banana wallet per stock and strategy; fractional shares; no loans or deposits
method.randomness: same MT19937 draws and regime paths across variants; shared-noise variants mix independent common and individual Gaussian shocks
method.selection: parameters and both seeds fixed before results; seed two is hold-out; no tuning during run
